description: Base ERC-20 pre-trade check from the chain itself in one call: contract or not, name, symbol, supply, owner and renounced status, upgradeable-proxy slots, mint/blacklist/pause/fee-setter selectors in the bytecode, Uniswap v3 pools vs WETH and USDC with quote-side balances, risk flags and a 0-100 score (token=0x...). Static inspection, no buy/sell simulation. Not financial advice. Pay per call $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.
